## Overview

KsPanel
-------
Named content container used by ks-accordion, ks-tabs, etc.

Usage:
<ks-panel key="profile">
  Profile content
</ks-panel>

<ks-panel key="settings">
  Settings content
</ks-panel>

## Properties

| Property | Attribute | Description                                      | Type     | Default     |
| -------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `name`   | `name`    | Name that maps to an accordion item or tab item. | `string` | `'ksPanel'` |
